import pandas as pd

def clean(df):
    df = df.drop_duplicates()
    species_mapping = {
        "Gentoo": "Gentoo",
        "Gentto": "Gentoo",
        "Adeile": "Adelie",
        "Chinstarp": "Chinstrap",
        "Chinstrap": "Chinstrap",
        "Adelie": "Adelie",
        "Gentoo": "Gentoo",
        "Adelie": "Adelie",
        "": "NaN"
    }
    df["species"] = df["species"].apply(lambda x: species_mapping.get(x, x))
    df = df[df["species"] == "Adelie"]
    allowed_islands = ["Biscoe", "Dream", "Torgersen"]
    df = df[df["island"].isin(allowed_islands)]
    df["bill_length_mm"] = df["bill_length_mm"].clip(lower=30, upper=60)
    df["flipper_length_mm"] = df["flipper_length_mm"].clip(lower=0, upper=230)
    df["body_mass_g"] = df["body_mass_g"].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)
    df["body_mass_g"] = df["body_mass_g"].clip(lower=2500, upper=6500)
    df["year"] = df["year"].clip(lower=2007, upper=2009)
    return df

def answer(df):
    return df.groupby("island")["bill_length_mm"].mean().to_dict()
